deckSettings.title: Deck Settings [{{name}}]
deckSettings.cardSortOrderDesc: Controls how the card list is ordered by added time. Applies to All, New, and Learning; Mastered, Today, and Tomorrow are not affected.
deckSettings.newCardsPerDayDesc: Maximum number of brand-new cards introduced each day
deckSettings.reviewLoadDesc: Controls how many previously-learned cards you review daily. When reviews pile up, the system may pause new cards at higher intensities until the backlog clears.
deckSettings.targetRetentionDesc: The fraction of cards you aim to recall at each review. Higher means more frequent reviews.
deckSettings.dedupDesc: Block cards with identical content when adding or editing
deckSettings.autoSpeakDesc: Automatically read card text aloud during practice (English only)
deckSettings.aiExplanationDesc: Prompt for analysing card Side A / Side B
deckSettings.promptCacheWarning: Changing a prompt invalidates the AI cache for this deck — new requests will be regenerated.
deckSettings.sideCompletionDesc: When only one side is filled, AI generates the other side automatically
deckSettings.promptSideAPlaceholder: Tell AI how to generate content from Side A
deckSettings.promptSideBPlaceholder: Tell AI how to generate content from Side B
deckSettings.promptCompletionPlaceholder: Tell AI how to generate the other side from existing content
deckSettings.maskModeDesc: Masks the question face text during practice to aid recall. Randomly selects some questions to mask the whole face; Full masks every question. Mask Mode requires a TTS language plugin.
deckSettings.maskModeEnabledDesc: When off, nothing in this deck is masked regardless of random or full mode.
